name: Jesse Woodhull
bioAdditions: Path confirmed in two compiled sources: Bull Smith -> Richard 2d -> Sarah Smith (b. 13 Feb 1700, m. 1716 Nathaniel Woodhull of Mastic) -> Jesse: 2nd cousin 9 times removed (Woodhull Genealogy S1; Pelletreau S3). The proposed Topping route (via Richard Woodhull II's wife Temperance) is doubtful: the Woodhull Genealogy calls her a Fordham (see Abraham Woodhull). His daughter Hannah (b. 8 Jul 1761) married Oliver Smith of Moriches, a Bull Smith cousin (S3).

conflicts.foundValue: Temperance (wife of Richard Woodhull II) was a daughter of Rev. Jonah Fordham per Woodhull Genealogy and Howell
conflicts.assessment: Drop the Topping route unless Temperance's parentage is proven.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Bull Smith route sourced; Topping route doubtful.
